BiblicalUsage: Karpophoros is fruit-bearing — fruitful, the word Paul uses for the seasons themselves. God left not Himself without witness, in that He did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that fruitful seasons are God's witness to the nations: rain from heaven and food and gladness, given even to those who never thanked Him.
